# uzc_marketplace_apps (Data Source)

Lists UzCloud marketplace apps. Read-only: the spec exposes no create/update/delete for this catalog.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "uzc_marketplace_apps" "all" {
  region = "barcelona-spain"
}

output "marketplace_app_slugs" {
  value = [for a in data.uzc_marketplace_apps.all.apps : a.slug]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

### Optional

- `region` (String) Filter by region slug.
